findings.highlight: the trees are rustling as if shivering with fear
findings.evidenceJa: 木々は山の胎動に震えるようにざわついていた
findings.governingReading: the trees rustled as though trembling at the mountain’s fetal stirrings
findings.explanation: The trees’ response to the mountain’s bodily convulsion becomes an unsupported emotion of fear.

findings.highlight: the Ryuudou Temple was poisoned
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺が形容しがたい毒素を孕んでいる
findings.governingReading: Ryuudou Temple harbored or was pregnant with an indescribable toxin
findings.explanation: The organic image of the temple containing a nameless toxin is flattened into a completed poisoning.

findings.highlight: Something strange is waiting for her.
findings.evidenceJa: 何か異質なモノが、自分と彼らを待ち受けている。
findings.governingReading: something alien is waiting for her and the others
findings.explanation: The alien presence’s threat to Saber, Shirou, and Rin is reduced to generic strangeness directed only at Saber.

findings.highlight: She takes a big breath.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は深く吸い込んだ息を吐いて、体調を整える。
findings.governingReading: [on page3] she exhales the deep breath she has drawn and regulates her condition
findings.explanation: A preparatory breath from the final countdown is moved into Saber’s earlier resolve, altering the beat and duplicating its function.

findings.highlight: She cannot afford to make a mistake.
findings.evidenceJa: この先、一手たりとも誤る訳にはいかない。
findings.governingReading: from here on, she cannot misplay even a single move
findings.explanation: The tactical insistence on not getting even one move wrong is generalized.

findings.highlight: She can only use her holy sword twice.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖剣は撃てて二回。
findings.governingReading: the holy sword can be fired at most twice
findings.explanation: The firing limit is stated less precisely as a simple use count.

findings.highlight: She cannot think of anything else but to use the holy sword
findings.evidenceJa: 聖剣の一撃を以って打倒する以外ない。
findings.governingReading: there is no way to defeat him except with a single blow of the holy sword
findings.explanation: The necessary defeat by one decisive strike becomes merely Saber’s inability to imagine another action.

findings.highlight: Go after thirty minutes, Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: 三十分経ったら始めて
findings.governingReading: start after thirty minutes, Saber
findings.explanation: Rin’s timing instruction governs the start of the attack, not simply Saber’s departure.

findings.highlight: sets her condition.
findings.evidenceJa: 体調を整える。
findings.governingReading: regulates and readies her physical condition
findings.explanation: The bodily preparation is rendered as non-English technical wording.

findings.highlight: Wind blows down from the mountaintop.
findings.evidenceJa: 山頂より風が漏れる。
findings.governingReading: wind leaks from the summit
findings.explanation: An unnatural leakage from the corrupted summit becomes ordinary wind blowing downhill.

findings.highlight: The last Servant should appear at the temple.
findings.evidenceJa: 境内には倒すべき最後のサーヴァントが現れる筈だ。
findings.governingReading: the last Servant she must defeat should appear in the temple grounds
findings.explanation: The combat location and Saber’s explicit designation of the enemy she must defeat are weakened.

findings.highlight: She cannot disobey her Master’s order.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターの命令には逆らっていない。
findings.governingReading: she has not disobeyed her Master’s order
findings.explanation: Saber’s self-justifying claim that she technically complied becomes a general inability to disobey.

findings.highlight: her master’s life
findings.evidenceJa: 主の命
findings.governingReading: her Master’s life
findings.explanation: The contractual title is inconsistently reduced to a common noun inside the same explanation.

findings.highlight: a raging wind that blows the pollution away
findings.evidenceJa: 汚れを斬り払う突風だった。
findings.governingReading: a sudden gust cutting the defilement away
findings.explanation: The cutting, cleansing motion is replaced by generic raging force.

findings.highlight: the mountain’s chill
findings.evidenceJa: 山門より滲み出る悪寒
findings.governingReading: the ominous chill seeping from the mountain gate
findings.explanation: The supernatural sensation is relocated from the gate to the mountain and weakened to temperature.

findings.highlight: The silver armor shoots up to the temple like a bullet.
findings.evidenceJa: 銀の甲冑は弾丸となって山頂を目指していく。
findings.governingReading: the silver armor becomes a bullet aimed at the summit
findings.explanation: Saber’s target is narrowed from the summit to the temple building.

findings.highlight: the longsword
findings.evidenceJa: 五尺を超える長刀
findings.governingReading: a long sword exceeding five shaku
findings.explanation: The explicit extraordinary blade length disappears.

findings.highlight: There is no elegance in Saber’s voice.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの声に色はない。
findings.governingReading: there is no color or affect in Saber’s voice
findings.explanation: Saber’s stunned emotional blankness becomes a judgment that her speech lacks elegance.

findings.highlight: She cannot be calm in the face of these surprises.
findings.evidenceJa: その二つのまさかが、彼女から冷静さを奪っていた。
findings.governingReading: those two impossible contingencies robbed her of composure
findings.explanation: The paired impossibilities and their active effect on Saber are generalized.

findings.highlight: even with the evil wind swirling about
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントにとって悪寒でしかない魔風を背にして
findings.governingReading: with his back to a magical wind that can feel only like a chill of dread to a Servant
findings.explanation: The wind’s specific supernatural effect on Servants disappears.

findings.highlight: The swordsman is acting casually
findings.evidenceJa: 長刀の剣士は何一つ変わらなかった。
findings.governingReading: the long-bladed swordsman remained utterly unchanged
findings.explanation: Assassin’s actual invariance under the malignant wind becomes an interpretation that he is acting casually.

findings.highlight: hosts
findings.evidenceJa: 依り代
findings.governingReading: anchor or vessel
findings.explanation: A specific anchoring concept is rendered as the broader and misleading “host.”

findings.highlight: It is this mountain in my case.
findings.evidenceJa: それがこの山門という事になる
findings.governingReading: in my case, that anchor is this mountain gate
findings.explanation: Assassin’s anchor is relocated from the bounded gate to the entire mountain.

findings.highlight: Whathe land is the host…?
findings.evidenceJa: な土地が、依り代だと
findings.governingReading: the land is your anchor?
findings.explanation: Missing characters and spacing corrupt Saber’s shocked question.

findings.highlight: Servants, ones without form, cannot maintain other Servants even if they are magi.
findings.evidenceJa: いかに魔術師と言えど、実体を持たぬサーヴァントにサーヴァントは維持できぬ。
findings.governingReading: even if she is a magus, a Servant without a physical body cannot sustain another Servant
findings.explanation: The rule about Caster’s inability to sustain another Servant without an era-bound anchor becomes a malformed general statement.

findings.highlight: I will not disappear as long as the mountain exists
findings.evidenceJa: この山門がある限り消える事はない
findings.governingReading: I will not disappear so long as this mountain gate exists
findings.explanation: The finite anchor is expanded from the gate to the mountain, implying much broader persistence.

findings.highlight: that is only borrowed time
findings.evidenceJa: それも日雇いにすぎんがな。
findings.governingReading: even that is merely day labor
findings.explanation: Assassin’s lightly self-deprecating temporary-hire metaphor disappears.

findings.highlight: His white arm is transparent like glass.
findings.evidenceJa: 白い腕は、ガラス細工のように透けていた。
findings.governingReading: his white arm was translucent like delicate glasswork
findings.explanation: The crafted delicacy and partial translucence of the failing arm are reduced to generic transparent glass.

findings.highlight: Assassinyou…
findings.evidenceJa: アサシン貴方は
findings.governingReading: Assassin, you…
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation and spacing fuse Saber’s address.

findings.highlight: It is just luck that kept me alive this long.
findings.evidenceJa: ここまで持ち堪えた事こそ僥倖
findings.governingReading: the very fact that I endured this long is a stroke of fortune
findings.explanation: An evaluation of his unlikely endurance becomes a causal claim that luck sustained him.

findings.highlight: He is demanding a meaningless battle.
findings.evidenceJa: 勝利も敗北も介さぬ
findings.governingReading: with neither victory nor defeat entering into it
findings.explanation: The defining indifference to the duel’s outcome disappears.

findings.highlight: a meaningless battle
findings.evidenceJa: 意味のない殺し合い
findings.governingReading: a meaningless fight to the death
findings.explanation: A mutual killing contest is softened into an ordinary battle.

findings.highlight: turn into meaningless words
findings.evidenceJa: 詰まらぬ言葉に成り下がる
findings.governingReading: degrade into banal or paltry words
findings.explanation: Assassin refuses to verbalize the motive because it would become trite, not because the words would lack meaning.

findings.highlight: He laughs.
findings.evidenceJa: くつくつという笑い。
findings.governingReading: a low, suppressed chuckle
findings.explanation: Assassin’s controlled, cultivated laugh is generalized.

findings.highlight: in the worst casethey
findings.evidenceJa: 最悪
findings.governingReading: in the worst case, they
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses the conditional phrase to its subject.

findings.highlight: There is no longer a reason to follow that command.
findings.evidenceJa: もはや門を守る意味などあるまい
findings.governingReading: there can no longer be any meaning in guarding the gate
findings.explanation: Saber’s appeal to the purpose of guarding is changed into obedience to Caster’s command.

findings.highlight: Nofirst of all
findings.evidenceJa: いやそもそも
findings.governingReading: No—first of all
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation and spacing fuse Assassin’s correction.

findings.highlight: the true identity of this Servant
findings.evidenceJa: このサーヴァントの真名
findings.governingReading: this Servant’s True Name
findings.explanation: A formal Servant-system term is replaced with generic identity.

findings.highlight: His ‘past’ was falsely forged as a convenient foe to a famed swordsman.
findings.evidenceJa: 人々の記録だけで剣豪とされた人物だ
findings.governingReading: a person made into a master swordsman solely by people’s records
findings.explanation: The culmination of Assassin’s account—that records alone constituted the swordsman—disappears.

findings.highlight: You area fictional heroic spirit?
findings.evidenceJa: 架空の、英霊ですが、貴方は
findings.governingReading: You are a fictional Heroic Spirit?
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses “are” and the article.

findings.highlight: the best suited for this role
findings.evidenceJa: 佐々木小次郎という殻、それを被るに最も適した剣士
findings.governingReading: the swordsman best suited to wear the shell called Sasaki Kojirou
findings.explanation: The shell metaphor that separates the nameless man from the recorded persona disappears.

findings.highlight: I was not fortunate enough to be given one.
findings.evidenceJa: 名前を持つほど余裕のある人間ではなかった
findings.governingReading: I was not a man with enough margin in his life even to possess a name
findings.explanation: Material deprivation and lack of human latitude become arbitrary bad fortune in name-giving.

findings.highlight: blocks her way as if to fulfill his role.
findings.evidenceJa: その役柄を貫き通さんと立ちはだかる。
findings.governingReading: stands in her way intent on carrying that role through to the end
findings.explanation: Assassin’s resolve to complete the imposed role is weakened into uncertain appearance.

findings.highlight: a match with a superior swordsman who he could not have been allowed to witness
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち会う事も許されなかった、上等すぎる剣士との対決
findings.governingReading: a confrontation with a swordsman too exalted for the nameless man even to be allowed to face
findings.explanation: The nameless swordsman’s exclusion from participating in such a duel becomes exclusion from merely witnessing it.

findings.highlight: to fight him.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ剣を合わせる事のみ。
findings.governingReading: only to cross swords with him
findings.explanation: The specifically swordsmanlike form of Saber’s answer is generalized.

findings.highlight: My life will end no matter what. There can be no better end than to die at your hand!
findings.evidenceJa: もとより花と散るこの身。その最期をそなたで迎えられるのであらば、これ以上の幕はあるまい
findings.governingReading: this body was always to scatter like a flower; if I may meet its end with you, no final curtain could surpass it
findings.explanation: Assassin’s linked flower, performance, and final-curtain imagery is reduced to a blunt wish to die by Saber’s hand.

findings.highlight: His longsword wavers.
findings.evidenceJa: 翻る長刀。
findings.governingReading: the long sword wheels or flashes back around
findings.explanation: A decisive reversal of the blade becomes hesitation or instability.

findings.highlight: Noshe does not know
findings.evidenceJa: 否全力で戦ったとしても
findings.governingReading: No—even if she fights at full strength
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation and spacing fuse Saber’s internal correction to its subject.

findings.highlight: gets more fierce with each blow
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃毎に鋭利さを増していく。
findings.governingReading: grows sharper with every strike
findings.explanation: Increasing technical sharpness becomes generic ferocity.

findings.highlight: A swordsman who can match a heroic spirit
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊と互角以上に戦う剣豪
findings.governingReading: a master swordsman who fights a Heroic Spirit on equal or superior terms
findings.explanation: The possibility that Assassin exceeds a Heroic Spirit in sword combat is omitted.
